integrity: The proof is symbolic for all q>=2 and positive m,n; direct finite tests are corroboration and not an infinite certificate. The inspection of relevant primary sources and residual priority risk are documented in AUDIT.json and REVIEW.md.
scientific_limitations: The exact classification applies to full powers of two opposite permutations of the same alphabet, not arbitrary strings or incomplete periods. The ordinary LCS is only lower-bounded in the separation consequence. Indexed and unindexed equivalent prior work remains possible.
